- 10–15m security / procurement clarifications and next steps

Can you share a couple of preferred windows for Alyssa and whoever from procurement/security needs to join? Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood-SE-Prep-Agenda.pdf (PDF, 214 KB)], [Attachment: SOC2-summary.xlsx (XLSX, 120 KB)]

If any of the proposed times are painful, we can do a split: engineer deep-dive + follow-up security call the same day.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
